text:
maria: Quick kickoff — need to settle scope for a focused observability sprint next week. Customer asks summarized: per-route cost breakdown, basic trace hooks (trace_id propagation + UI flag), and error-sample deep links. Can we target a "launchable" MVP by end of next week?
kevin: Backend notes: we have the cost attribution proto mostly done, UI surface needs a small mapping layer. Trace hooks require a prod-safe header capture path — dev branch exists but needs testing. Error deep links are low-effort if we standardize the URL format.
sasha: +1 on feasibility, but two caveats: 1) sampling & retention policy for traces (we need defaults), 2) PII in traces — legal check required before GA.
oliver: To keep the sprint small, propose scope cuts: ship per-route cost only for Hosted initially (show dedicated/private as "coming soon"), and implement trace capture as a boolean flag that surfaces trace_id when present. Error deep links = quick win.
maria: OK proposed launch criteria (compact):
```
- Hosted per-route cost UI (token/routing map, 7d cost rollup)
- Trace hook: capture X-Redwood-Trace header -> display trace_id link in error details
- Error analytics: link to raw logs / trace when available (one-click)
- Basic dashboard template for customer (cost + error rate + traces)
- Feature flag + canary rollout plan
```
kevin: Timeline sketch: backend PRs by Tue EOD, UI by Thu EOD, canary + QA Fri. Risk: sampling config could cause unexpectedly high trace volume — set default to 0.1% and allow override. Also note retention/egress cost for traces.
sasha: @maria please get a pilot customer and confirm legal on PII. For dedicated/private, we need an opt-in toggle (customer-managed) — not in MVP.
maria: I will loop in solutions + legal this morning. Prioritization ask: if pilot committed, we bump this as top sprint. Quick thumbs?
kevin: :thumbsup:
oliver: :thumbsup: but prefer not to displace infra sprint — propose small overtime for UI to avoid swap.
maria: Consensus: prioritize if pilot confirmed. We'll ship behind flag and do canary in Hosted region eu-west-1 first. I'll follow up with a short runbook and acceptance checklist.
deploy-bot: canary flag created: `obs-per-route-v1` for eu-west-1.
maria: Thanks — next steps: I will post a short runbook + customer pilot invite in #product and loop legal. If pilot falls through we cut trace hook to "capture-only" mode and defer UI polish.
kevin: Noted. I'll slot PRs and add the sampling default to the config (0.001).
sasha: Added note: retention must be configurable before GA.
maria: Great — I'll update the roadmap doc and post a follow-up thread with exact PR links and feature-flag IDs.
